foo4_cb.smtDecl: (declare-fun foo4_cb ((_ BitVec 64) (_ BitVec 64) (_ BitVec 64) (_ BitVec 64)) (_ BitVec 64))
foo4_cb.desc: foo4_cb takes four 64-bit numbers, computes their sum modulo 8, but if the result is 1, it instead returns 2. Hence, the function can return any value in {0,2,3,4,5,6,7} but never 1.
